description:
Retrieves details of a specific task instance from a Managed Airflow environment.

Use this tool to retrieve details of a specific task instance, such as its state,
start time, end time, or parameters, to understand its status or to debug a failure.

This tool does not return task instance logs directly. Instead, use the
`cloud_logging_filter` field from the response to query Cloud Logging for the logs for
this task instance.

dagRunId.description: Required. The Airflow DAG run ID.

environment.description: Required. The name of the environment. Format: `projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/environments/{environmentId}`

mapIndex.description: Optional. For mapped tasks, the map index of the task. It should not be populated for non-mapped tasks.

name: get_task_instance

outputSchema.description: Task instance in a DAG run.

cloudLoggingFilter.description: Output only. A Cloud Logging filter that can be used to retrieve the logs of this task instance.

dagId.description: The DAG ID of the DAG whose execution is described by the DAG run the taskInstance belongs to.

dagRunId.description: The DAG run ID the task instance belongs to.

endDate.description: Timestamp when the task instance finished execution.

hostname.description: Hostname of the machine or pod the task runs on.

id.description: The task instance ID. It is the same as the task ID of a DAG.

isDynamicallyMapped.description: Whether this TaskInstance is dynamically mapped.

mapIndex.description: If is_dynamically_mapped is set to true, this field contains index of the dynamically-mapped TaskInstance, If is_dynamically_mapped is set to false, this field has no meaning.

maxTries.description: The number of tries that should be performed before failing the task.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the task instance, in the form: "projects/{project_id}/locations/{location_id}/environments/{environment_id}/dags/{dag_id}/dagRuns/{dag_run_id}/taskInstances/{task_instance_id_with_optional_map_index}".

note.description: The note content of the task instance. Added in Airflow 2.10.0.

pool.description: The slot pool this task runs in.

priorityWeight.description: Priority weight of this task against other tasks.

queue.description: Which queue to target when running this task.

queuedDttm.description: Timestamp when the task was queued.

renderedMapIndex.description: Named mapping - a rendered map index template for this task instance. If task doesn't have a template specified or is_dynamically_mapped is set to false, this field is empty.

runAfter.description: Timestamp when the parent DAG run was scheduled to start. Added in Airflow 3.

startDate.description: Timestamp when the task instance started execution.

x-google-enum-descriptions: The state of the task instance is unknown.
Task vanished from DAG before it ran.
External request to shut down (e.g. marked failed when running).
External request to restart (e.g. cleared when running).
Deferrable operator waiting on a trigger.

taskId.description: The task instance ID. It is the same as the task ID in the DAG.

taskType.description: The operator used in this task.

tryNumber.description: The try number that this task number will be when it is actually run.
